input.task: Add an Export as CSV button to the reports page. The export must respect the filters currently applied and must work for guest accounts as well as members.
input.plan: 1. Add an Export as CSV button beside the existing PDF export control. 2. Create a /reports/export.csv endpoint that serializes the current report query. 3. Pass the active filter parameters from the page to the new endpoint. 4. Add an integration test that exports a filtered report and checks the rows match the filtered view.
